AnimalReport.title: AnimalReport
AnimalReport.description: Report of a dangerous animal hazard sighting (snake, aggressive dog, etc.) in the neighborhood

id.description: Unique identifier of the animal report pin

animalType.description: Category of dangerous animal (SNAKE, AGGRESSIVE_DOG, RABID_ANIMAL, etc.)

label.description: Short headline of the hazard report

description.description: Details regarding animal appearance, behavior, and threat level

locationName.description: Landmark or street location of the sighting

xRatio.description: Horizontal coordinate ratio on the neighborhood vector map

yRatio.description: Vertical coordinate ratio on the neighborhood vector map

status.description: Current status of the threat: PENDING (active) or DONE (secured)

reportedBy.description: Display name of the reporting community member

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who submitted the report

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the report was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the report was last updated

/pins/{pinId}.description: Collection of dangerous animal sighting pins reported by community members

/users/{userId}.description: User profile records indexed by auth UID
